name: fx::Normalize

name: cTSParticlesEffect::CollideColliders
notes: Particles_CollideColliders: the sweep's distance is the size curve times the effect's size scale times the particle's size (an x87 multiply, curves kept finite), the alpha curve if over 1, the variance's |s|+1 if nonzero, the world scale; the move vector comes by value (ret 0x10) and the sweep gets its address; the visible byte becomes the sweep's bool argument (zero = 1). Returns a bool: false when a collider killed the particle. Lane WV mutants (forces family, Particles_Attractors / Colliders / CollideColliders / Forces): 26 mutants, 25 killed, 1 survivor argued unreachable: 'force 4 reject lower bound' needs a random triple whose sum of squares is in [0, 1e-4).

name: cTSParticlesEffect::AttractorForce
notes: Particles_Attractors: the description's byte 2 and 3 scale the offsets by its three factors, 4 pulls to the radius (a random unit vector for a point on the centre), anything else is centre minus point. Lane WV mutants (forces family, Particles_Attractors / Colliders / CollideColliders / Forces): 26 mutants, 25 killed, 1 survivor argued unreachable: 'force 4 reject lower bound' needs a random triple whose sum of squares is in [0, 1e-4).

name: cTSParticlesEffect::SumAttractors
notes: Particles_Attractors: this is the vector (ecx); the stop flag, when given, is set by a force inside the minimum distance or by a zero force with a positive minimum distance; checked with and without the pointer, three passes, the last on a centre. Lane WV mutants (forces family, Particles_Attractors / Colliders / CollideColliders / Forces): 26 mutants, 25 killed, 1 survivor argued unreachable: 'force 4 reject lower bound' needs a random triple whose sum of squares is in [0, 1e-4).

name: fx::SweepColliders
notes: Particles_Colliders: cdecl, ten arguments; the owner's slot 8 (2) skips the lot; a hit with probability p draws a random only when p is neither 0 nor 1; a kill spawns the second text; the drag path takes the global at 0x10fd170 (never written) when the drag is not below the squared speed. name: cTSParticlesEffect::CollideSurface
notes: Particles_Surface (and Forces): the surface's height (slot 5, x87 float) and normal (slot 6) at the particle's x, y in the surface's space; terrain repel (flag 0x20000) pushes up by a force over the depth, kills below a limit; else a reflection with the bounce factor, a death chance (a random drawn only when strictly between 0 and 1), the rotated normal when the world is rotated. Stand-in: the surface object is a fake (class unidentified); its normal fake writes all 12 bytes. Lane WV mutants (Particles_Surface / Forces): 41 mutants + 5 aimed at the survivors after the test was strengthened with edge cases built from the surface script, all killed. The height comes back on the x87 stack as a float: the original reads it with fstp dword [esp+..] straight after call eax (0xbb8758, 0xbb8882); ours calls slot 5 as float(__thiscall*)(void*, float, float) so the compiler pops st(0) the same way; the test's fake is a float-returning function, so it too leaves its float in st(0). The runner fails a test that leaves the x87 stack unbalanced. The surface's concrete class is not identified.

name: cTSParticlePath::Evaluate
notes: Particles_PathEvaluate: before the first / after the last point carried on at the end velocity only if the flag bit says; between: a cubic Hermite with the weights in the original's order; a duration of 1e-6 or less (ordered) copies the earlier point; NaN times and probes included; an empty path is undefined and not tested. Lane WV mutants (Particles_Integrate*, family run of the nine integrate/steer/path functions): 103 + 5 aimed at the survivors, 108 in all, 102 killed; 6 equivalent: dispatch mask high (the mask is a 32-bit constant), substeps remaining (remaining - step against - dt; the loop ends either way), substeps ordering (<= against < is the same value when equal), substeps old pos (an identical copy), substeps alive and steered alive (alive equals mAlive != 0 whenever ApplyForces returned true).

name: cTSParticlesEffect::SteerAlongPath

name: cTSParticlesEffect::InitParticle
notes: Lane WV. Particles_Init: 6000 seeds, odd ones at 24-bit x87 precision; every path of the function drawn on purpose (ring, ellipsoid, box; velocity from position, tiny length, bomb incl. NaN and zero distance; path placed and not; facing axis; stretch with and without the scene; rotation counts 0..3, range and flat; constrain set and unset), the particle bytes, the generator and the fakes' event log compared, and the test fails if a branch was never reached. Stand-ins: the scene's slot 140 (0x230; thiscall (out, 0); fills 0x1c bytes of out with the 0xa5 pattern by FillOut and answers with a pointer to a scripted position+quaternion, which is what the original reads) and the constrain object's slot 3 (thiscall (local, world, position, offset), ret 0x10; logs both transforms, moves the position). Mutants: 62, 58 killed (4 edge cases needed new test cases: tiny threshold exactly, bomb at zero distance); 2 equivalent: tiny abs (a sum of squares is never negative) and bomb zero test (!(b == 0) is b != 0). The stretch block reads the size curve at t = 0 (ORIGINAL-BUG, probably). A path with no points is undefined (not tested); a rotate count above 3 reads the description past its two pairs (not tested: it reads a curve's pointers). Hooked.

name: fx::ParticlePosition

name: cTSParticlesEffect::Step
notes: Lane WX. Slot 5, the effect's step (our cTSParticlesEffect::AddToScene), in effect through its callers (the vtable Create installs). Particles_Effect_Frame: 1200 seeds x 32 frames, our step on one object against the game's 0xbb6830 on a twin, fingerprints of the effect, its particles, the pool, the events and the fakes after every frame; every integrator class, the five substep flags alone, colliders placed, the stretch limit and the axis-only velocities built on purpose, preroll re-armed, dead particles before the step, a shape on a third of the seeds.
